image_description: Three Star Trek: The Next Generation comic books fanned out on a dark, textured surface. The covers feature illustrated characters (Worf, Captain Picard, Deanna Troi, Geordi La Forge) in dynamic poses, bold title typography, and publisher logos (DC Comics/WildStorm). The physical objects show glossy paper stock, rectangular proportions, and visible spine edges.
